properties.name: velocity.enabled
properties.description: Enable velocity checks that flag suspicious fund transfers for review

properties.name: velocity.per-transaction-amount-threshold
properties.description: A single transfer strictly above this amount is flagged for review

properties.name: velocity.daily-amount-threshold
properties.description: Flag when the day's transfer total (including the current transfer) is strictly above this amount

properties.name: velocity.daily-count-threshold
properties.description: Flag when the day's transfer count (including the current transfer) is strictly above this number

properties.name: velocity.zone-id
properties.description: Time zone used for calendar-day boundaries in the daily velocity checks
